title: Popular initiative for a 13th AHV pension (Initiative fuer eine 13. AHV-Rente)
description: Trade-union and SP-backed popular initiative introducing a 13th monthly old-age pension. As SP co-president, Meyer was a leading campaigner. Approved by 58.2 percent of voters and a majority of cantons, the first time a union initiative expanding social benefits was accepted. Meyer reacted: 'We did it!'

title: Premium Relief Initiative (Praemien-Entlastungs-Initiative)
description: SP popular initiative to cap health-insurance premiums at 10 percent of disposable income, with additional costs borne by federal and cantonal governments. Meyer was a prominent public advocate, appearing in televised debates. The initiative was rejected by voters on 9 June 2024.
role: Leading campaigner (SP co-president); proponent in public debates
